areas.label: area:api
areas.desc: the service: domain, storage, HTTP API

risk_high: authentication and authorisation, anything that crosses a tenant, anything that moves money, secrets, CI/CD

verify.board: npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && node ../rumble-framework/scripts/check-anchors.mjs . && node ../rumble-framework/render.mjs . --check
verify.extra: TypeScript on Node 24, one package. Tests are `node --test` and run offline against an in-memory database.

implementers.name: ledger-dev
implementers.description: Implements Ledger work — the service, the UI, infra and docs. Follows the issue spec and the engineering standards; verifies before opening a PR.
implementers.rules:
- Money is never a float: integer minor units with an explicit currency.
- The tenant is the boundary: no query crosses one without saying so in its name.
